page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn1ne.8xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores on an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor operating at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a ratio of 2.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or GPU hardware, relying instead on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a clear divergence between single-core and multi-core performance. Single-core metrics, such as stress-ng and Geekbench single-core scores, fall into the bottom 25% tier, reflecting the older Broadwell-generation architecture. However, multi-core performance scales to average levels, as demonstrated by Passmark CPU and Geekbench multi-core scores. Memory bandwidth remains average for large block operations, though the overall Passmark memory score is weak.

This hardware profile is best suited for highly parallelized workloads that can leverage all 32 dedicated cores, such as multi-threaded decompression, software compilation, static web serving, and medium-sized language model inference. Because of its older processor architecture, the instance provides a cost-effective option for resource-dense, multi-threaded computing where peak single-core speed is not a critical requirement.
